message.text:
The s3presign runner keeps externally-stored attachment links from going stale.

It runs every 12 hours. It refreshes S3 presigned URLs that expire after 5 days. It is wired into server startup via `Start()` calling `startBackgroundRunners()` in `server/server.go`.

The exact wiring site is `server/server.go:129`, where `Start()` calls `startBackgroundRunners()`. The runner is instantiated at `server/server.go:162`.

The runner calls `RunOnce` immediately on startup, then begins its 12-hour ticker loop at `runner.go:27`.

The component is s3presign.Runner.

It runs every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup via Server.Start() → startBackgroundRunners(). The wiring site is server/server.go:129.

Reconsidering whether the runner actually refreshes externally-stored attachment content. It appears to handle only S3 storage types. EXTERNAL attachments may store direct reference URLs without presigning. Checking attachment_service_storage.go to confirm.

"Externally-stored attachment content" refers to S3 storage in this codebase.

s3presign.Runner refreshes presigned S3 URLs before they expire. It runs every 12 hours. The runner is started in server/server.go at line 129.

The runner also fires once immediately at startup. Its 12-hour interval is defined at server/runner/spresign/runner.go:273.
